array.string: mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/mpm" /opt/homebrew/bin/mpm --no-color --table-format json outdated > "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json" 2> "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.log" status=$? if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then rm -f "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.error" else printf 'mpm outdated failed (exit %s) at %s -- see ~/.cache/mpm/plan.log\n' "$status" "$(date)" > "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.error" fi
